response.sql: SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.name

assumptions.assumption: Entries with NULL points are excluded by the points >= 6.0 filter. AVG ignores NULL wins and returns NULL if a group has no non-null wins. Races with no qualifying entries do not appear, because the filter is applied before grouping.
